serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
OpenBlue Workplace Platform is a cloud-based platform that combines OpenBlue Workplace and OpenBlue Employee to deliver Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS) and Workplace Experience (WEX) capabilities for managing facilities, real estate, assets, and workplace operations.

The platform supports space and occupancy management, strategic planning, room, desk, and resource scheduling, service request management, event and visitor management, asset and facility maintenance, move management, real estate and lease administration, facility project management, reporting and analytics, and interactive floor plans.

Authorized administrators can configure data fields, forms, workflows, notifications, reports, role-based access controls, and business rules to meet organizational requirements. The platform also supports integrations with Microsoft Outlook, HR data sources, IoT utilization sensors, workplace booking hardware, and AutoCAD and Revit tools for the publication, synchronization, and management of digital floor plans and workplace data.
